levels.surface: عبد الله بن عمر بن سعيد الأشج

notes: «ورواه جماعة» names the group of six, not a link: the six are the first level.

Ibn Mas'ud's answer is the saying, but he speaks inside Masruq's narrated scene («جاء رجل إلى عبد الله بن مسعود فقال»): source, or only in the scene? Rule 11 (a narrated encounter); not added, so the chain ends at Masruq.
«قالوا جميعا حدثنا أبو أسامة» converges the six on one level (rule 2).
